why: CPCA 405 ¶3 defines holidays as the official public holidays and weekly rest days under the texts in force, and 405 ¶4 extends a period ending on a non-working day; the list of public holidays (from memory: law 63-278 as amended, grade D) is not in the store, so the extension of d5 cannot be checked.
Same rule (CPCA 405 ¶3-¶4): the text fixing the weekly rest days (from memory a 2009 decree setting Friday and Saturday, grade D; exact reference unknown) is not in the store.
